answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue gains and no measurable retention harm. Memory 44 provides strong evidence through improved enterprise conversion and pipeline quality, though it omits realized revenue and retention. Memories 31, 86, and 91 report upstream activation, onboarding, or engagement outcomes without connecting them to qualified revenue or long-term retention; memory 31 is somewhat stronger because the lift was durable. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but omits discount economics, customer quality, retention, and post-promotion sustainability. Memory 91 is least supported because week-one engagement and first-action gains are relatively distant proxies for sustainable long-term qualified revenue.
